record.label: Eigenstate input and zero-initialized ancillas
record.statement: The resource estimate includes one run of phase estimation on a 63-electron eigenstate. The circuit starts all ancillas at zero and prepares the phase-gradient state during that run.
record.boundary: For ideal phase estimation, a trial state $|\phi\rangle$ gives the mixture of eigenstate outcome distributions with weights $|\langle\psi_j|\phi\rangle|^2$. Appendix I.1 uses this to explain the single-run accounting. Preparing a trial state and repeating phase estimation to sample its ground-state component carry additional costs.
